title: AI 要跨越盧比孔河了嗎?自我成長的 AI 離我們多遠 (下集)

topic_alignment.paraphrase: Lee distinguishes the desired human objective, the instruction H, and the loss inferred by the agent. The question about loss of control starts earlier at 3747.577 s.
Lee introduces peacock tails and discusses mate attraction and a possible survival cost. The four-panel visual is a teaching analogy.

In the hypothetical initial range, a slightly longer tail signals good condition. With stronger preference the relationship can break down. The PDF says survival; at 3901.430 s the lecture describes healthy offspring and later generations.
Lee introduces the fictional film I, Robot, its three rules and VIKI’s interpretation. He names welfare as an example of the implicit desired outcome and identifies both H and L(H).

closing_remarks.paraphrase: The ability to improve and the ability to improve the improvement mechanism may grow together. In the final segment Lee argues that an intrinsic objective can sustain progress and that people may need to monitor its direction.

additional_anchors.paraphrase: Can growth get out of control?
Lee expands the slide label survival into healthy descendants and the next generation.
